1. (Currently amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, __wherein the escalated alarm has a different characteristic than the first alarm__.

2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer, __and wherein acknowledgment of the second alarm prevents transmission of the output to initiate the escalated alarm__.

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm, __and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm__.

4. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm, __and wherein the escalated alarm is triggered only upon non-acknowledgment of both the first and second alarms__.

6. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously, __and wherein the escalated alarm is triggered at a different time than the first and second alarms__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system, __and wherein the central patient management system includes a user interface for acknowledging the second alarm__.

16. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to escalate the alarm upon non-acknowledgment; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and __an escalation status indicating whether the alarm has been escalated__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, __and wherein the system is capable of communicating with remote devices to transmit alarm notifications__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, __wherein the level of escalation indicates a progression from initial alarm to escalated alarm__.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, __including a timestamp of when the alarm was acknowledged and by which user or device__.

20. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices, __wherein the alarm data is sent only upon escalation of the alarm or upon expiration of a predetermined acknowledgment period__.
